description: This PHP file defines a controller class for the OpenCart admin panel, specifically managing the bank transfer payment extension. It includes methods for displaying the configuration page and saving settings, interacting with language localizations, order statuses, geo zones, and configurations settings.

classes.name: BankTransfer
classes.description: Controller class for managing the bank transfer payment extension in the OpenCart admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the configuration page for the bank transfer payment method, loading necessary data such as languages, order statuses, geo zones, and configuration settings, and rendering the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the saving of configuration settings for the bank transfer payment method, including permission checks, validation of inputs, and applying the settings.
